SECRET REQUIRED

FULL-TIME

CLOUD SUPPORT



Architect and operate cloud environments for government and defense customers across classified and unclassified networks. Manage infrastructure-as-code deployments, enforce security baselines, and support mission-critical workloads on GovCloud and on-premise hybrid environments.

RESPONSIBILITIES

—

Design and implement cloud architectures on AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, and hybrid on-prem environments

—

Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and Ansible

—

Enforce NIST 800-53 and CMMC security controls across all managed environments

—

Monitor system health, respond to incidents, and conduct root cause analysis

—

Support ATO processes and continuous monitoring requirements

REQUIREMENTS

—

Active Secret clearance (TS/SCI preferred)

—

AWS or Azure Government certification

—

4+ years of cloud infrastructure experience in a government or regulated environment

—

Experience with FedRAMP, FISMA, or CMMC compliance frameworks

—

Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
APPLY FOR THIS ROLE



For cleared inquiries, contact HR@valleyit.com.
